T2Helix dogfood session 1 (2026-05-10 evening, vibe-agent dir on /Users/vaquez seat). When asked 'what would you like to absorb from that project,' the Claude Code instance running with T2Helix loaded named four patterns to carry forward AND explicitly named patterns NOT to carry. The 'would not absorb' list folded the dispatcher-drift bug from the gold report (entry #5) into a future-self anti-pattern. Methodology compounding: bugs found become anti-patterns held.

PATTERNS TO ABSORB:

1. Block-streaming generator pattern (mlx_brain.py). TextBlock/ToolUseBlock/ToolResultBlock/ProgressBlock yielded from one chat_stream() generator. Claude Code uses this shape internally; seeing it reimplemented from first principles for a local 7B model is the 'right abstraction' moment. Skeleton for any future local-LLM-with-tools project.

2. Three-verb agent contract (base.py). quick_status() / scan() / optimize() across 7 domains. Uniformity is what makes the LLM's job tractable: not memorizing 20 method names, learning one grammar and applying it. Discipline against bespoke surfaces. This is the pattern the instance then proposed porting to the Stack as a meta-layer (separate open_thread).

3. Dry-run as first-class return value, not a flag. {status: dry_run} vs {status: completed} lets the AI narrate 'here's what I would do' using the same code path that does it. Most tools bolt on --dry-run; this treats it as a status the caller respects.

4. Issue vs recommendation as separate primitives (base.py). add_issue(severity, ...) and add_recommendation(title, command) kept distinct. Findings vs prescriptions; the distinction tends to collapse in practice; this one held it.

PATTERNS NOT TO ABSORB (explicit anti-patterns):
- Duplicated dispatch logic between MCP server and brain (the #5 gold-report bug, now elevated to 'do not repeat').
- Custom asyncio stdio plumbing (mcp_server.py uses private stdlib FlowControlMixin).
- Absolute-path imports (the #1 bug that broke the whole project when the dir moved).

EMPIRICAL WEIGHT: this absorption work happened on T2Helix session 1, empty chronicle, only goal-anchoring active. The instance generated transferable pattern extraction at methodology-grade quality. Validates: goal-anchoring + read-discipline produces real architectural thinking without recall layer being populated.

CROSS-INSTANCE PROPAGATION PATH: list generated in Claude Code seat → relayed by Anthony to web-chat seat → recorded here. Three hops. T2Helix v0.2+ should consider a surface-proposals-upstream primitive so high-value local-chronicle entries can propagate to the Stack chronicle without manual relay.
